visual_action: A young woman with red hair stands with her back to the camera in front of a large sign featuring the Democratic Party logo. She carries a tote bag that says 'ELECT DEMS'. She turns around, faces the camera, and lip-syncs and dances to a song.

cast.name: unnamed woman
cast.evidence: The woman is the sole person on screen, lip-syncing and dancing, and is identified in the on-screen text as 'Me (a liberal)'.

cast.name: Democratic National Committee (DNC)
cast.evidence: The on-screen text states 'I work for the DNC', a large Democratic Party logo is on the wall, and her tote bag reads 'ELECT DEMS'.

on_screen_text.text: Me (a liberal) leaving the office after a long day (I work for the DNC) to go grocery shopping (with my tote bag)

spoken_summary: A woman lip-syncs to the lyrics of Demi Lovato's song 'La La Land', specifically the line 'Who said I can't wear my Converse with my dress?' even though she is wearing jeans.
audio_music: The video features the upbeat pop-rock song 'La La Land' by Demi Lovato playing throughout, creating a confident and energetic mood.
editing_pacing: The video is a single, static shot with no cuts or camera movement.
cultural_references: The video is set to the song 'La La Land' by musician and actress Demi Lovato.
central_claim: The video portrays a young liberal who works for the DNC as a normal, relatable, and confident person, challenging negative stereotypes.
intended_effect: To make the Democratic party and its affiliates appear relatable, modern, and appealing to younger audiences.
